chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-ʿAzramī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
That ʿAlī عليه السلام amputated a grave-robber.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, the transmitter of the report in the matn
key_terms.عَلِيًّا: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, the one whose judicial ruling is being reported
key_terms.قَطَعَ: carried out amputation as a legal punishment
key_terms.نَبَّاشًا: a grave-robber; one who exhumes graves to steal from them

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Shia hadith on the punishment of a grave-robber?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal judgment of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام concerning grave-robbing. It is cited within the chapter on prescribed punishments, indicating its relevance to judicial rulings and the administration of justice in cases of theft-related crimes.
